questions.stem: What is the main constituent of an acid?
questions.solution: The main constituent of an acid is the hydrogen ion (H⁺), as acids are defined by their ability to donate protons. Hydroxide and oxide ions are associated with bases, which accept protons. Chloride ions are not a general constituent of all acids, only specific ones like hydrochloric acid.

hi.stem: एसिड का मुख्य घटक क्या है?
hi.solution: एसिड का मुख्य घटक हाइड्रोजन आयन (H⁺) है, क्योंकि एसिडों की परिभाषा इसके प्रोटॉन देने की क्षमता द्वारा की जाती है। हाइड्रॉक्साइड और ऑक्साइड आयन क्षारकों से जुड़े हुए हैं, जो प्रोटॉन ग्रहण करते हैं। क्लोराइड आयन सभी एसिडों के सामान्य घटक नहीं हैं, केवल विशिष्ट एसिड जैसे हाइड्रोक्लोरिक एसिड में होते हैं।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology used in Hindi textbooks.

mr.solution: अम्लाचा मुख्य घटक हायड्रोजन आयॉन (H⁺) आहे, कारण अम्लांची प्रतिकृती प्रोटॉन देण्याच्या क्षमतेवर आधारित आहे. हायड्रॉक्साइड आणि ऑक्साइड आयॉन बेससह संबंधित आहेत, जे प्रोटॉन ग्रहण करतात. क्लोराइड आयॉन सर्व अम्लांचा सामान्य घटक नाहीत, केवळ विशिष्ट अम्लांसारखे हायड्रोक्लोरिक अम्लासाठी असतात.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology appropriate for a Marathi-medium curriculum.

questions.stem: What happens when an acidic solution is mixed with a solution of baking soda?
questions.solution: When an acidic solution is mixed with a solution of baking soda, a gas is released because the acid reacts with the baking soda, producing carbon dioxide gas. The solution does not remain unchanged, nor does it turn blue or become more acidic, as those outcomes do not result from this type of chemical reaction.

questions.stem: Which of the following substances is a base?
questions.solution: Baking soda is a base because it has a bitter taste and feels slippery, which are characteristics of basic substances. Vinegar, lemon juice, and orange juice are all acidic and do not exhibit the properties of bases.

questions.stem: Which of the following is used to neutralize excess acid in the stomach?
questions.solution: Magnesium hydroxide is used to neutralize excess acid in the stomach because it is a mild base that reacts with stomach acid to form water and a salt. Sodium, calcium, and potassium hydroxides are strong bases and can be harmful if ingested, making them unsuitable for this purpose.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about indicators?
choices: Indicators are used to taste acids and bases
Indicators change colour in the presence of acids and bases
Indicators are always strong acids or bases

questions.solution: Indicators change colour in the presence of acids and bases because they are sensitive to pH levels. They are not used for tasting, as that would be unsafe and inaccurate. questions.stem: What is the function of an indicator in a chemical reaction?
choices: To change the pH of the solution
To measure the temperature of the solution
To show the presence of acid or base
To increase the concentration of the solution
questions.solution: An indicator is used to show the presence of acid or base by changing color in response to the pH of the solution. It does not alter the pH, measure temperature, or change the concentration of the solution, as those are not its functions.

questions.stem: A student added a few drops of an unknown solution to phenolphthalein and the solution turned pink. What can be concluded about the unknown solution?
questions.solution: Phenolphthalein turns pink in basic solutions and remains colorless in acidic ones. Since the solution turned pink, it must be a base. Acids would not cause a color change, and neutral or salt solutions also do not react with phenolphthalein to produce pink.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true about the reaction between an acid and a base?
questions.solution: When an acid reacts with a base, a neutralization reaction occurs, producing salt and water. This is a fundamental chemical reaction where both substances are neutralized. The other options are incorrect because new substances are always formed, and not just water or just salt.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन अम्ल और क्षार के अभिक्रिया के बारे में सत्य है?
hi.solution: जब अम्ल क्षार के साथ अभिक्रिया करता है, तो उदासीनीकरण अभिक्रिया होती है, जिसमें लवण और पानी बनते हैं। यह एक मूलभूत रासायनिक अभिक्रिया है जहां दोनों पदार्थ उदासीन हो जाते हैं। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि हमेशा नए पदार्थ बनते हैं, और केवल पानी या केवल लवण नहीं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, structure, and technical terms. The correct answer remains option (2), and all distractors are still incorrect.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणता विधान अम्ल आणि आधान दरम्यानच्या ऍक्शनबद्दल खरा आहे?
choices: कोणतेही नवीन पदार्थ तयार होत नाहीत
mr.solution: जेव्हा अम्ल आधानशी ऍक्शन करतो, तेव्हा न्यूट्रलायझेशन ऍक्शन होतो, जो लवण आणि पाणी तयार करतो. हे एक मूलभूत रासायनिक ऍक्शन आहे जेथे दोन्ही पदार्थ न्यूट्रल केले जातात. इतर विकल्प अयोग्य आहेत कारण नवीन पदार्थ नेहमी तयार होतात, आणि केवळ पाणी किंवा केवळ लवण नाही.
